title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-rpj4: test_invalid_method_is_rejected_before_dh regex mismatch
description:
## Bug: test_invalid_method_is_rejected_before_dh regex mismatch

**File:** `python/tests/crypto/test_edhoc.py:454`

**Root cause:** After refactoring `process_message_1` to use `_validate_int` for METHOD_CORR and SUITES_I validation, the error message format changed. When METHOD_CORR is a valid integer but represents a mismatched method, the error message is now `"Method mismatch: expected 0 got 1"` instead of something containing `"METHOD_CORR"`.

**Impact:** The test at line 454 uses `pytest.raises(ValueError, match="METHOD_CORR")` which will NOT match the new error message. The test will fail with `AssertionError: Regex pattern did not match. Regex: 'METHOD_CORR' Input: 'Method mismatch: expected 0 got 1'`. This is currently masked by a pre-existing `NameError` for `edhoc_module` (line 451).

**Fix needed:** Either:
1. Update the test regex to match `"Method mismatch"` or `"expected 0 got"`, OR
2. Update the error message in `edhoc.py` to include `"METHOD_CORR"` so the regex matches

**Also:** The pre-existing `NameError: edhoc_module is not defined` at line 451 and 526 needs a separate fix (missing `import lichen.crypto.edhoc as edhoc_module`).
